name: boox-companion
title: BOOX Companion
description: Browse, transfer files, and capture the screen of BOOX devices over your local network
author: metrovoc

commands.name: boox
commands.title: BOOX
commands.description: Browse your BOOX library, notes, and storage

commands.name: send-to-boox
commands.title: Send to BOOX
commands.description: Send files to storage or add documents to the BOOX library

commands.name: quick-send-selected-files
commands.title: Quick Send Selected Files
commands.description: Send the files selected in Finder to the configured BOOX inbox

commands.name: open-boox-screen
commands.title: Open BOOX Screen
commands.description: Open the BOOX screen stream in a native viewer

commands.name: capture-boox-screen
commands.title: Capture BOOX Screen
commands.description: Copy the current BOOX screen to the clipboard

commands.name: capture-boox-region
commands.title: Capture BOOX Region
commands.description: Select and copy a region from the current BOOX screen

commands.name: boox-status
commands.title: BOOX Status
commands.description: Show BOOX status and quick actions in the menu bar

preferences.name: manualHost
preferences.title: Device Address
preferences.description: Optional BOOXDrop address. Leave empty to discover devices automatically. Passwords require HTTPS.

preferences.name: quickSendDirectory
preferences.title: Quick Send Inbox
preferences.description: Storage directory used by Quick Send Selected Files.

preferences.name: downloadDirectory
preferences.title: Download Directory
preferences.description: Optional local destination. Defaults to Downloads/BOOX.

preferences.name: scanVirtualInterfaces
preferences.title: Network Discovery
preferences.description: Also scan VPN and virtual private-network interfaces.
preferences.label: Scan VPN interfaces

scripts.build: npm run build:native && ray build -e dist
